scripts.name: Link local context
scripts.command: for f in AGENTS.local.md CLAUDE.local.md; do [ -e "$f" ] || [ ! -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" ] || ln -s "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" "$f"; done

scripts.name: Check (Go)
scripts.command: u="$(git ls-files -z '*.go' | xargs -0 gofmt -l)"; { test -z "$u" || { printf '%s\n' "$u"; false; }; } && go vet ./... && go test ./... -race
